proposal.rationale: Maya Ellis's squat depth rose from 61.3° to 85.3° while load on the affected leg fell from 47.9% to 36.8% over the last 21 days, a compensation pattern. Pain after back-to-back days averaged 6/10. Suggest a rest day between squat days and a weight-shift drill.

sql: WITH w AS (SELECT v.patient_id, p.name, p.affected_side, v.day, v.p95_knee, v.affected_load_pct, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.patient_id ORDER BY v.day) AS first_n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.patient_id ORDER BY v.day DESC) AS last_n, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY v.patient_id) AS days FROM progress_v AS v JOIN patients AS p ON p.id = v.patient_id WHERE v.exercise_id = 'squat' AND v.affected_load_pct IS NOT NULL AND v.day >= CAST((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS DATE) - 21) SELECT patient_id, name, affected_side, MAX(days) AS days, ROUND(CAST(AVG(p95_knee) FILTER(WHERE first_n <= 3) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS depth_from, ROUND(CAST(AVG(p95_knee) FILTER(WHERE last_n <= 3) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS depth_to, ROUND(CAST(AVG(affected_load_pct) FILTER(WHERE first_n <= 3) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS load_from, ROUND(CAST(AVG(affected_load_pct) FILTER(WHERE last_n <= 3) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS load_to, ROUND(CAST((AVG(affected_load_pct) FILTER(WHERE first_n <= 3) - AVG(affected_load_pct) FILTER(WHERE last_n <= 3)) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS load_drop FROM w WHERE days >= 6 GROUP BY patient_id, name, affected_side HAVING AVG(p95_knee) FILTER(WHERE last_n <= 3) - AVG(p95_knee) FILTER(WHERE first_n <= 3) > 5 AND AVG(affected_load_pct) FILTER(WHERE first_n <= 3) - AVG(affected_load_pct) FILTER(WHERE last_n <= 3) > 2 ORDER BY load_drop DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200
